titulo: Why does my shower have low water pressure?

frases.texto: Why is your shower just a trickle?
The holes are packed with white chalk, so the water can't get out.
Open the sink. If that blasts, the clog is in the showerhead.
If only the hot side is weak, leave the water heater alone.
Hold the arm still. A cloth if it's stuck, then twist the head to the left.
If the arm starts turning, stop, and call a plumber.
Soak the head in white vinegar, holes down, for one hour.
A thick crust can sit overnight. Gold or brass: thirty minutes only.
Scrub the holes with an old toothbrush, and rinse.
Screw it back on to the right, by hand.
The spray comes roaring back. Once a month, the same soak keeps the chalk away.
If every tap is weak, open the main valve all the way. Already open? Call a plumber.
Send this to that friend whose shower barely dribbles.
